name: searchmd
description: 조사 자료(글·사진·링크)를 붙여넣어 슬라이드로 정리하는 웹 편집기

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.cf:create: wrangler pages project create searchmd --production-branch main
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name searchmd --branch main
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name searchmd --branch preview
